{{Quote|Since the hypergate opened, only hostiles have emerged. Some are sentient, some automatons. Many Gree and Republic bisectors have been terminated.|[[Gatemaster]] [[Beltek'k]]|<ref name="TfB" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] the now-rogue [[Dread Masters]], after their [[Battle of Denova|failure]] on [[Denova]], resurrected their proxy [[Kephess]] and sent him and a composited army to occupy the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] world of [[Asation]] and in particular the [[Grand Hypergate]]; from there the Masters extracted many eldritch creatures so the Gree called for help from both the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] powers for dispatched strike teams to in order to '''combat''' the Dread's plans.<ref name="TfB" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The raid on Asation is a 8-16 players operation in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It first appeared in the "Game Update 1.4: Terror From Beyond" released on [[September 26]], [[2012]].<ref name="TOR-update">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/1.4-terror-from-beyond|text=Game Update 1.4: Terror From Beyond}}</ref>
